name: Amaoto no Kaerimichi
source:
Despite work going okay, this and that happens, leading the protagonist to feel despondent. One day, while on his way home in the pouring rain, he meets a strange girl in a raincoat.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20992]Freem![/url]]
translation:
主角的工作原本还算顺利，却接连遭遇种种烦心事，逐渐变得消沉。一天，倾盆大雨中，他在回家路上遇见一个穿着雨衣的奇怪女孩。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/20992]Freem![/url]]
